_doc: The announcement strip under the header (components/notice-bar.php, filtered by NT_Alert::notices()). Keys per notice: id (stable - the visitor's dismissal is remembered against it, so give re-worded messages a NEW id), tone (info|success|warning|error|note|question), icon (NT_Icons name or emoji), badge_text, title, message, button_label + button_url, or button_label + dialog (a key from dialogs.json), pages (array of page keys, or omit for every page), starts / ends (site-timezone dates - omit for always), dismissible, status (active|draft).
